column_description:
JSONB column. Captures identifying details of the attorney, including name, address, firm, and court affiliation.
Fields: {"address":{"city":"TEXT. City of the attorney. Example: Cincinnati.","country":"TEXT. Country of the attorney. Possible values: CANADA, UNITED STATES OF AMERICA.","line1":"TEXT. Primary address line for the attorney. Example: 302 West Third Street.","line2":"TEXT. Secondary address line for the attorney. **NULL means no secondary address provided.**. Example: Suite 710.","province":"TEXT. Province or region of the attorney. **NULL means no province specified.**. Example: Ontario.","state":"TEXT. State of the attorney. Example: OH.","zip":"TEXT. Postal code for the attorney. Example: 45202."},"contact":{"extension":"BIGINT. Extension number for the attorney’s phone. **NULL means no extension provided.**. Example: 7375.0.","phone":"BIGINT. Phone number for the attorney. Example: 15133818472.0."},"firm":"TEXT. Law firm name or business name. Example: Musillo Unkenholt, LLC..","highest_court":{"name":"TEXT. Name of the highest court the attorney is registered with. **NULL means no court name provided.**. Example: Supreme Court of Ohio.","state":"TEXT. State of the highest court the attorney is registered with. **NULL means no state provided.**. Example: OH."},"name":{"first":"TEXT. First name of the attorney. Example: Maria.","last":"TEXT. Last name of the attorney. Example: Schneider.","middle":"TEXT. Middle initial of the attorney. **NULL means no middle initial provided.**. Example: T.."}}
